rule_1_open_low.name: Open = Low Institutional Signature
rule_1_open_low.logic: When Open equals Low (within 0.15%), institutional market orders absorbed all sell pressure at 9:15 AM. 99.47% close green.
rule_1_open_low.action: Immediate Long bias on first 5m pullback with SL at Open.

rule_2_open_high.name: Open = High Institutional Dump Trap
rule_2_open_high.logic: When Open equals High (within 0.15%), institutions dumped inventory at the open. 99.70% close red.
rule_2_open_high.action: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN to Buy. Look only for Short entries or avoid.

rule_3_sector_confluence.name: Sector Alignment Filter
rule_3_sector_confluence.empirical_impact: Single biggest differentiator between 10 winners and 10 losers.
rule_3_sector_confluence.logic: Stocks in green sectors (Metals, Energy, Realty) have 85%+ follow-through. Stocks in red sectors (IT today) fail 80%+ of breakout attempts.
rule_3_sector_confluence.action: Never take a Long trade in a stock whose sector index is below VWAP.

rule_4_demand_dip_vs_breakout.name: Camarilla L3 / Demand Zone Asymmetry
rule_4_demand_dip_vs_breakout.logic: Buying at Camarilla L3 (e.g. DLF 689) offers 1:3.5 Risk:Reward with 0.5% risk. Chasing late breakouts (DLF 701) offers poor 1:0.5 R:R.
rule_4_demand_dip_vs_breakout.action: Prefer pre-market limit orders at L3/Order Block over late breakout chasing.

rule_5_time_windows.morning_confirmation: 09:45 - 10:15 AM IST (Filters morning shakeouts; establishes real institutional trend)
rule_5_time_windows.midday_chop_avoidance: 11:30 - 01:30 PM IST (Low volume chop; never enter new positions)
rule_5_time_windows.btst_closing_surge: 02:45 - 03:15 PM IST (Stocks closing near Day High on 1.5x volume gap up next morning)

rule_6_crypto_character.stop_hunt_rule: Bitcoin always hunts retail stops below key support before pumping, or above resistance before dumping.
rule_6_crypto_character.action: Never short red candle bottoms at CMP. Wait for the fakeout wick to complete, then enter on retest.
